example.english: Keep the milk cold in the fridge.
example.chinese: 把牛奶放在冰箱里冷藏。

example.english: Sit near the window if you need more light.
example.chinese: 如果你需要更多光线，就坐在窗边。

example.english: The choir gave a wonderful performance.
example.chinese: 合唱团带来了一场精彩的演出。

example.english: The red dress has two deep pockets.
example.chinese: 这条红色连衣裙有两个深口袋。

example.english: Autumn is my favourite season for hiking.
example.chinese: 秋天是我最喜欢的徒步季节。

example.english: Your seat is here, next to mine.
example.chinese: 你的座位在这里，就在我的座位旁边。

example.english: It took me twenty minutes to do my maths homework.
example.chinese: 我花了二十分钟做数学家庭作业。

example.english: This road leads directly to the village.
Please write your name below the picture.
example.chinese: 请把你的名字写在图片下面。

example.english: His cough kept him awake at night.
example.chinese: 他的咳嗽让他夜里无法入睡。

example.english: The leaves turn yellow in late autumn.
Zero comes before one on the number line.
example.chinese: 在数轴上，零在一的前面。
